source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: Where to Find & Use the Backstreet Cellar Crank
source_excerpt:
While exploring Pangzhen , you will fight the Lion Dance Grandmaster , who drops the Flaming Mane Phantom Edge. However, you will need to progress a little further in the main story before you can use it to access the southwest side of the region and reach the Back Hill Pavilion Bell.
From here, you can explore the Slums to find either the Backstreet Cellar Crank or the place where it needs to be used. This guide covers both locations and how to complete A Mother's Heart .
Where to Find the Backstreet Cellar Crank in Phantom Blade Zero
Image via GameRant | Sources: S-GAME
From the Back Hill Pavilion Bell, make your way down while dealing with the enemies along the path, then use the chain to reach the other side. Defeat the enemy on the rooftop, drop down to the roof below, and deal with the enemies there as well.
Jump down to the balcony and continue toward the rooftop ahead. Look to the right for a climbable wall, then climb up and drop down on the left. You will reach an area with a purple chest, a raised ladder, and a few enemies.
Deal with the enemies before opening the chest to obtain the Backstreet Cellar Crank. With the crank collected, drop the ladder in front of you and pick up the Memory Flower nearby. This will start the A Mother's Heart quest.
Where to Use the Backstreet Cellar Crank in Phantom Blade Zero
After collecting the Memory Flower, make your way northeast toward the Pangzhen Slums and continue to Old Man Gen's House Bell. Head slightly south of this Bell to find the location where you can insert the Backstreet Cellar Crank. Using it will open the cellar door, allowing you to enter.
Inside, collect the Tainted Crystal Shard and deal with the Puppets in the area. Then climb the ladder to find a Shield Puppet. Defeat it and continue ahead until you reach another ladder that you can drop down.
Loot the chest for resources and collect the second Memory Flower to complete A Mother's Heart. As a reward for completing the quest, you will receive Merciful Dew Medicine.
After this, you can continue exploring Pangzhen or go to the Mandate Encampment with the Outer Gate Key you acquired some time ago.
